title: Create ethics policies
goal: The few rules the venture will not break are written as a decision the founder took, each with a real case it would have decided differently, and the way a concern is raised names who hears it and what happens next.

steps.do: Read the alignment record, the governance pillars, the decision rights and the constraints and list the commitments the venture has already made, so a new policy restates nothing and contradicts nothing.

Draft the few rules that would actually change a decision, what the venture will not sell, whose data it will not collect, what it will not claim, each with a real case it would have decided differently, and leave adopting them to the founder.
Ask the founder who hears a concern about conduct, how someone raises it and what happens next, and write the answer plainly, including that in a one-person venture the answer is the founder alone.
Name the open decision each rule bears on and add it there as evidence, and propose to the strategy lead which rule to adopt first, the one a waiting decision needs.

done_criteria.check: Does every rule name a real case it would have decided differently, and does the record say who hears a concern and what happens next?
